breakdown.description: The volume fractions for air and water at the inlet are set to 0.8 and 0.3. Their sum is 1.1, which violates the physical principle that the sum of all phase volume fractions must equal 1.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains alpha.water = 0.3 at the inlet, identical to the flawed original prompt. The ground truth corrects this to 0.2 so that alpha.air (0.8) + alpha.water (0.2) = 1.0. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
